name: South Fork Shoshone River — Hunter Creek to Andy Martin Hill
gaugeName: South Fork Shoshone River Ab Buffalo Bill Res, WY (USGS 06281000)
blurb: South Fork Shoshone River: sections between Wyoming Game and Fish Department river access points.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Hunter Creek (SF Shoshone): not mapped (WGFD lists the site but no agency facility coordinate was found within 300 m in WGFD, BLM, USFS or NPS layers). Take-out Mariposa Bridge (aka Ishawooa) (SF Shoshone): not mapped (WGFD lists the site but no agency facility coordinate was found within 300 m in WGFD, BLM, USFS or NPS layers). Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal.
